we propose a semi-supervised deep learning based Urdu speech recognition system, which achieves a WER of 4% on a standard Urdu ASR dataset.

the proposed model achieves a WER of 4% better than the benchmark on the Urdu corpus.

improving the generalization of neural networks for ASR in Urdu, a low resource language.
improving ASR for low resource languages by incorporating SSL and regularization techniques.
the development of an ASR system for a low-resource language like Urdu, using semi-supervised deep learning techniques.

the proposed model achieves a significant improvement over the benchmark HMM model, while being regularized and using SSL techniques.
the proposed approach of regularizing a neural network with semi supervised learning achieves better results than HMM for Urdu ASR.
the proposed approach is able to improve the ASR performance for low resource languages, such as Urdu, by utilizing semi supervised learning techniques.
